remarks: Centrally located, this freshly painted, bright and updated unit close to downtown and shops is a great find! A balcony, generous closet space, brand new kitchen appliances, bathroom vanity, lighting, and laminate floors throughout kitchen and living room, and like new carpeting in both bedrooms will make you feel right at home while being only minutes from all Stamford has to offer. This beautiful complex boasts 24-hour security, a pool, laundry room, and a gym. Close to I-95 and Stamford Train Station. ****HEAT AND HOT WATER INCLUDED**** Pets under 40 lbs are allowed for an additional fee. Great credit and references a must. 1 parking spot is included, a second spot may be available for an additional fee.
